_note: Schedule structure for ENGINEER '26. The three days are real (23—25 October 2026, as given in the fest brief). Every `slots` array is intentionally EMPTY: no event in this repo has a confirmed time or venue, and inventing them would put wrong information in front of attendees. Fill slots in as the organising team confirms them — the /schedule page renders whatever is here, so no code change is needed.

_slotShape.event: event slug from data/events.json, or null for non-event items (breaks, ceremonies)
_slotShape.title: string — required; for event slots use the event's real name
_slotShape.track: string or null — e.g. 'Main Arena', used to group parallel sessions

_weekdayNote: Weekday is DERIVED from `date` at render time — never stored here, so it can't contradict the date if dates change.
